findings.title: D10 is optional metadata — A1-D9-V14-01 not actually closed
findings.detail: check-d9.py gates D10 on `if maps and ax` and skips comparison when expected is missing. Deleting codeMaps or a used entry leaves class-only D6 green. Author's resolve text and register notes that called V14-01 CLOSED overstated the repair. Same error class as CSI: silence without knowing what was examined.
findings.requiredFix: Require codeMaps structurally; fail if any non-none deficiency/rejection/fault lacks a map entry; fail if maps missing; mutation-test both deletions in self-test or retained negative controls.

findings.detail: Default path is d9-exit-contract.v1.4.json. Success string is 'D1..D9 clean'. Running the prescribed no-arg command does not exercise D10 or v1.5 at all.
findings.requiredFix: Default to register binding (v1.5); print D1..D10; version-assert binding.
